title: 雅思·图表与流程描述 · 96 句
description: 虚拟图表情境的句子翻译练习；中文已给出所需信息，无需配图。覆盖变化、比例、比较、预测、流程与地图；数值为练习设定。

items.zh: 图中显示，公交日均乘客数从两万人上升到三万人。
items.en: The chart shows that average daily bus passenger numbers rose from twenty thousand to thirty thousand.
answers: The chart shows that average daily bus passenger numbers rose from twenty thousand to thirty thousand.
items.notes: rose from A to B：从起点升至终点。

items.zh: 煤炭消费在最初三年下降，随后保持稳定。
items.en: Coal consumption declined during the first three years and then remained stable.
answers: Coal consumption declined during the first three years and then remained stable.
items.notes: then 表示变化阶段的先后。

items.zh: 周末的用电量围绕四百兆瓦时上下波动。
items.en: Weekend electricity use fluctuated around four hundred megawatt-hours.
answers: Weekend electricity use fluctuated around four hundred megawatt-hours.
items.notes: fluctuate around：围绕某数值波动。

items.zh: 酒店入住率在八月达到全年最高点。
items.en: Hotel occupancy reached its annual peak in August.
answers: Hotel occupancy reached its annual peak in August.
items.notes: reach a peak：达到最高点。

items.zh: 申请数量在四月降至最低，之后逐月回升。
items.en: Applications reached their lowest point in April before recovering month by month.
answers: Applications reached their lowest point in April before recovering month by month.
items.notes: before doing 连接相继变化。

items.zh: 与前年相比，去年的自行车销量翻了一番。
items.en: Bicycle sales last year were double those of the year before.
answers: Bicycle sales last year were double those of the year before.
items.notes: those 代指 sales，double 表示两倍。

items.zh: 人口增加了一千人，达到六千人。
items.en: The population increased by one thousand to reach six thousand.
answers: The population increased by one thousand to reach six thousand.
items.notes: by 表示增量，to 表示终值。

items.zh: 失业率从百分之八降至百分之六，下降了两个百分点。
items.en: Unemployment fell from eight to six per cent, a decrease of two percentage points.
answers: Unemployment fell from eight to six per cent, a decrease of two percentage points.
items.notes: percentage points 不等于百分比降幅。

items.zh: 住房支出占家庭总预算的三分之一。
items.en: Housing accounted for one third of the total household budget.
answers: Housing accounted for one third of the total household budget.
items.notes: account for：占某比例。

items.zh: 食品和交通的支出合计超过了娱乐支出。
items.en: Combined spending on food and transport exceeded expenditure on entertainment.
answers: Combined spending on food and transport exceeded expenditure on entertainment.
items.notes: combined spending：合计支出。

items.zh: 城镇家庭的互联网接入率比农村家庭高二十个百分点。
items.en: Internet access among urban households was twenty percentage points higher than among rural households.
answers: Internet access among urban households was twenty percentage points higher than among rural households.
items.notes: higher by a difference：明确差值单位。

items.zh: 两组之间的差距到期末已缩小到不足五百人。
items.en: By the end of the period, the gap between the two groups had narrowed to fewer than five hundred people.
answers: By the end of the period, the gap between the two groups had narrowed to fewer than five hundred people.
items.notes: had narrowed 表示截至过去时点已发生。

items.zh: 线上销售在二〇二〇年超过实体店销售，并在此后保持领先。
items.en: Online sales overtook shop sales in 2020 and remained ahead thereafter.
answers: Online sales overtook shop sales in 2020 and remained ahead thereafter.
items.notes: overtake：超过；thereafter：此后。

items.zh: 铁路是最受欢迎的选项，而轮渡使用人数最少。
items.en: Rail was the most popular option, whereas ferries had the fewest users.
answers: Rail was the most popular option, whereas ferries had the fewest users.
items.notes: whereas 对比两种排名。

items.zh: 除了三月，图书馆每个月的到访量都高于前一年同期。
items.en: Except in March, library visits were higher each month than in the corresponding month of the previous year.
answers: Except in March, library visits were higher each month than in the corresponding month of the previous year.
items.notes: corresponding month：对应月份。

items.zh: 较年轻人群偏好短视频，而年龄最大的一组更多选择电视。
items.en: Younger respondents favoured short videos, while the oldest group was more likely to choose television.
answers: Younger respondents favoured short videos, while the oldest group was more likely to choose television.
items.notes: while 表对比，不表示时间。

items.zh: 两家公司的销售额起点相同，但期末相差明显。
items.en: The two companies began with equal sales figures but finished with a substantial difference.
answers: The two companies began with equal sales figures but finished with a substantial difference.
items.notes: equal ... but ...：概括起终点差异。

items.zh: 尽管月度数据有波动，总体趋势仍然向上。
items.en: Despite monthly fluctuations, the overall trend was upward.
answers: Despite monthly fluctuations, the overall trend was upward.
items.notes: despite 后接名词，不接完整从句。

items.zh: 工厂产量在整个观察期内都没有超过五千件。
items.en: Factory output never exceeded five thousand units throughout the observation period.
answers: Factory output never exceeded five thousand units throughout the observation period.
items.notes: throughout：在整个期间。

items.zh: 预计到二〇三〇年，太阳能将成为最大的电力来源。
items.en: Solar power is projected to become the largest source of electricity by 2030.
answers: Solar power is projected to become the largest source of electricity by 2030.
items.notes: is projected to：预计，区别实际观测值。

items.zh: 总体来看，服务业就业增加，而农业就业减少。
items.en: Overall, employment in services increased, whereas agricultural employment declined.
answers: Overall, employment in services increased, whereas agricultural employment declined.
items.notes: overall 引出概述，避免加入未给出的原因。

items.zh: 该表只给出了总量，无法看出每个家庭的使用情况。
items.en: The table provides totals only, so usage by individual households cannot be determined.
answers: The table provides totals only, so usage by individual households cannot be determined.
The table provides totals only, so usage by individual households can't be determined.
items.notes: cannot be determined：资料无法支持判断。

items.zh: 生产过程首先将收集到的玻璃按颜色分类。
items.en: The production process begins by sorting the collected glass by colour.
answers: The production process begins by sorting the collected glass by colour.
items.notes: begin by doing：从某步骤开始。

items.zh: 瓶子清洗后被打碎，然后送入熔炉。
items.en: After being washed, the bottles are crushed and sent to a furnace.
answers: After being washed, the bottles are crushed and sent to a furnace.
items.notes: after being done：被处理之后。

items.zh: 熔化的材料被倒入模具，冷却后形成新的容器。
items.en: The molten material is poured into moulds, where it cools to form new containers.
answers: The molten material is poured into moulds, where it cools to form new containers.
items.notes: where 指代模具中的位置。

items.zh: 水蒸发后形成云，最终以降水的形式返回地面。
items.en: Water evaporates to form clouds and eventually returns to the ground as precipitation.
answers: Water evaporates to form clouds and eventually returns to the ground as precipitation.
items.notes: eventually 表示循环中的后续结果。

items.zh: 在分拣阶段，可回收物与其他垃圾被送往不同的处理路线。
items.en: At the sorting stage, recyclables and other waste are directed along separate processing routes.
answers: At the sorting stage, recyclables and other waste are directed along separate processing routes.
items.notes: separate routes：分开的处理路径。

items.zh: 第二次过滤完成之前，水不会进入储存罐。
items.en: Water does not enter the storage tank until the second filtration is complete.
answers: Water does not enter the storage tank until the second filtration is complete.
Water doesn't enter the storage tank until the second filtration is complete.
items.notes: not ... until：完成某步骤后才进入。

items.zh: 旧仓库被一个带停车场的购物中心取代。
items.en: The old warehouse was replaced by a shopping centre with a car park.
answers: The old warehouse was replaced by a shopping centre with a car park.
items.notes: be replaced by：被某物取代。

items.zh: 图书馆向东扩建，而原有入口仍在南侧。
items.en: The library was extended eastwards, while the original entrance remained on the southern side.
answers: The library was extended eastwards, while the original entrance remained on the southern side.
items.notes: eastwards 表示向东的方向。

items.zh: 一条新的步行道把住宅区与河边公园连接起来。
items.en: A new footpath linked the residential area to the riverside park.
answers: A new footpath linked the residential area to the riverside park.
items.notes: link A to B：连接两个位置。

items.zh: 尽管周围新增了住宅，村中心的教堂位置没有变化。
items.en: Although housing was added nearby, the church in the village centre remained in the same location.
answers: Although housing was added nearby, the church in the village centre remained in the same location.
items.notes: remained 强调地图中的保留部分。

items.zh: 步行占全部出行的四分之一，骑车占八分之一。
items.en: Walking accounted for a quarter of all journeys, compared with an eighth for cycling.
answers: Walking accounted for a quarter of all journeys, compared with an eighth for cycling.
items.notes: compared with 可对比两个份额；分母均为全部出行。

items.zh: 租房家庭的比例从百分之四十升至百分之五十，即增加了十个百分点。
items.en: The proportion of households renting their homes increased from 40% to 50%, a rise of ten percentage points.
answers: The proportion of households renting their homes increased from 40% to 50%, a rise of ten percentage points.
items.notes: percentage points 表示百分比之差，不是增长百分之十。

items.zh: 虽然会员人数翻了一番，会员占当地人口的比例却没有变化。
items.en: Although membership doubled, members made up the same proportion of the local population.
answers: Although membership doubled, members made up the same proportion of the local population.
items.notes: 数量翻倍不等于占比翻倍；made up：构成。

items.zh: 住宅用水和商业用水合计占总用水量的七成。
items.en: Residential and commercial use together represented 70% of total water consumption.
answers: Residential and commercial use together represented 70% of total water consumption.
items.notes: together 明确合并两类；consumption 不可数。

items.zh: 每百名居民拥有的汽车数量从三十辆降到了二十四辆。
items.en: Car ownership fell from thirty to twenty-four vehicles per hundred residents.
answers: Car ownership fell from thirty to twenty-four vehicles per hundred residents.
items.notes: per hundred residents 明确标准化分母。

items.zh: 全职学生人数更多，但兼职学生中的毕业生比例更高。
items.en: There were more full-time students, but a greater proportion of part-time students graduated.
answers: There were more full-time students, but a greater proportion of part-time students graduated.
items.notes: 区分人数比较和组内比例比较。

items.zh: 娱乐支出所占份额缩小了，尽管花在娱乐上的金额有所增加。
items.en: Entertainment took a smaller share of spending despite an increase in the amount spent on it.
answers: Entertainment took a smaller share of spending despite an increase in the amount spent on it.
items.notes: share 与 amount 分别指相对份额与绝对金额。

items.zh: 剩余的百分之十五分布在图中未单独列出的几个类别中。
items.en: The remaining 15% was distributed across several categories not listed separately in the chart.
answers: The remaining 15% was distributed across several categories not listed separately in the chart.
items.notes: remaining：剩余的；过去分词限定 categories。

items.zh: 报名人数的大部分增长发生在第二季度。
items.en: Most of the increase in enrolment occurred in the second quarter.
answers: Most of the increase in enrolment occurred in the second quarter.
items.notes: most of the increase 描述增长发生的阶段。

items.zh: 短暂回升之后，出口量再次下降，并在期末触底。
items.en: Following a brief recovery, export volumes declined again and bottomed out at the end of the period.
answers: Following a brief recovery, export volumes declined again and bottomed out at the end of the period.
items.notes: bottom out：降至最低点。

items.zh: 从七月开始，用电量一直维持在每月约六百兆瓦时的水平。
items.en: From July onwards, electricity consumption stayed at around six hundred megawatt-hours per month.
answers: From July onwards, electricity consumption stayed at around six hundred megawatt-hours per month.
items.notes: from ... onwards 表示从某时点起；兆瓦时是能量单位。

items.zh: 四个季度的降雨量交替上升和下降，没有持续朝一个方向变化。
items.en: Rainfall alternated between rises and falls across the four quarters, with no sustained movement in either direction.
answers: Rainfall alternated between rises and falls across the four quarters, with no sustained movement in either direction.
items.notes: alternate between：在两种状态间交替。

items.zh: 入场人数先迅速增加，随后增速逐渐放缓。
items.en: Attendance initially grew rapidly before the pace of growth gradually slowed.
answers: Attendance initially grew rapidly before the pace of growth gradually slowed.
items.notes: 增长放缓不代表总人数减少。

items.zh: 库存量在连续三个月下降之后才趋于稳定。
items.en: Stocks stabilised only after three consecutive months of decline.
answers: Stocks stabilised only after three consecutive months of decline.
items.notes: only after 强调稳定之前的连续下降。

items.zh: 前半段的降幅比后半段的回升幅度更大。
items.en: The fall in the first half of the period exceeded the subsequent recovery.
answers: The fall in the first half of the period exceeded the subsequent recovery.
items.notes: exceeded 对比变化幅度；subsequent：随后的。

items.zh: 夏季高峰过后，旅游收入到十一月已回落至一月的水平。
items.en: After the summer high, tourism revenue had fallen back to its January level by November.
answers: After the summer high, tourism revenue had fallen back to its January level by November.
items.notes: had fallen back 表示截至过去时点已回落；January level 为比较基准。

items.zh: 甲地区从第三位升至第一位，而乙地区跌至末位。
items.en: Region A moved from third to first place, while Region B slipped to the bottom of the ranking.
answers: Region A moved from third to first place, while Region B slipped to the bottom of the ranking.
items.notes: move from ... to ... 用于名次变化。

items.zh: 公交和地铁的平均通勤时间相同，均为四十分钟。
items.en: Buses and the underground recorded identical average commuting times of forty minutes.
answers: Buses and the underground recorded identical average commuting times of forty minutes.
items.notes: identical：完全相同的；average 限定所比较指标。

items.zh: 肉类支出略高于鱼类支出，两者都远低于住房支出。
items.en: Spending on meat slightly exceeded that on fish, with both well below housing costs.
answers: Spending on meat slightly exceeded that on fish, with both well below housing costs.
items.notes: that 替代 spending；both 指肉类与鱼类支出。

items.zh: 最大的两个年龄组加起来比其余所有年龄组的人数还多。
items.en: The two largest age groups together outnumbered all the remaining groups combined.
answers: The two largest age groups together outnumbered all the remaining groups combined.
items.notes: outnumber：人数超过；combined 强调合计。

items.zh: 四家工厂中，只有丙厂的产量下降了。
items.en: Of the four factories, only Factory C experienced a reduction in output.
answers: Of the four factories, only Factory C experienced a reduction in output.
items.notes: of the four 确定比较范围。

items.zh: 收入最低的组出现了最大的比例增幅，但其最终收入仍然最低。
items.en: The lowest-income group saw the largest proportional gain but still had the lowest final income.
answers: The lowest-income group saw the largest proportional gain but still had the lowest final income.
items.notes: proportional gain 与绝对增量不同。

items.zh: 三种燃料的价格在期初相近，到期末则明显分化。
items.en: Prices for the three fuels were similar initially but diverged markedly by the end.
answers: Prices for the three fuels were similar initially but diverged markedly by the end.
items.notes: diverge：逐渐拉开差异。

items.zh: 两条线路的客流量相差约两万人，红线较高。
items.en: Passenger numbers differed by roughly twenty thousand between the two lines, with the red line carrying more.
answers: Passenger numbers differed by roughly twenty thousand between the two lines, with the red line carrying more.
items.notes: differ by 接差额；with 结构补充较高的一方。

items.zh: 大多数包裹的重量在两至五公斤之间，超过十公斤的只有很少一部分。
items.en: Most parcels weighed between two and five kilograms, with very few exceeding ten kilograms.
answers: Most parcels weighed between two and five kilograms, with very few exceeding ten kilograms.
items.notes: very few 指可数的 parcels。

items.zh: 周末的日均到访量是工作日的三倍。
items.en: Average daily visits at weekends were three times those on weekdays.
answers: Average daily visits at weekends were three times those on weekdays.
items.notes: those 代替 visits；日均指标避免天数干扰。

items.zh: 中位工资基本未变，而平均工资明显上升。
items.en: The median wage remained largely unchanged, whereas the mean increased considerably.
answers: The median wage remained largely unchanged, whereas the mean increased considerably.
items.notes: median 是中位数；mean 是算术平均数。

items.zh: 婴儿用品的销售额占比较小，但单位售价最高。
items.en: Baby products generated a small share of sales revenue but had the highest price per unit.
answers: Baby products generated a small share of sales revenue but had the highest price per unit.
items.notes: 区分销售收入份额与单位售价。

items.zh: 图中的失业人数以千人为单位，而失业率以百分比表示。
items.en: Unemployment counts are given in thousands, while unemployment rates are expressed as percentages.
answers: Unemployment counts are given in thousands, while unemployment rates are expressed as percentages.
items.notes: counts 与 rates 使用不同单位。

items.zh: 调查对象中，独居者不足五分之一。
items.en: Fewer than one in five respondents lived alone.
answers: Fewer than one in five respondents lived alone.
items.notes: one in five：每五人中一人；fewer than 表示不足。

items.zh: 几乎所有的新增床位都集中在城区医院。
items.en: Almost all additional beds were concentrated in urban hospitals.
answers: Almost all additional beds were concentrated in urban hospitals.
items.notes: additional beds 指新增数量，而非全部床位。

items.zh: 第三组的数值范围最广，从十二到八十九不等。
items.en: The third group had the widest range of values, extending from twelve to eighty-nine.
answers: The third group had the widest range of values, extending from twelve to eighty-nine.
items.notes: range 描述最大值与最小值所界定的范围。

items.zh: 虚线表示二〇二五年之后的预计需求，而实线表示已记录的需求。
items.en: The dashed line shows anticipated demand after 2025, while the solid line represents recorded demand.
answers: The dashed line shows anticipated demand after 2025, while the solid line represents recorded demand.
items.notes: anticipated 与 recorded 区分预测和观测。

items.zh: 按照图中的预测，风能产量到二〇四〇年将接近水电产量，但不会超过后者。
items.en: Under the forecast shown, wind output will approach that of hydropower by 2040 without overtaking it.
answers: Under the forecast shown, wind output will approach that of hydropower by 2040 without overtaking it.
items.notes: that 替代 output；without overtaking 限定接近程度。

items.zh: 最乐观情景下的乘客人数比最保守情景下高出约三分之一。
items.en: Passenger numbers in the most optimistic scenario are approximately a third higher than in the most conservative one.
answers: Passenger numbers in the most optimistic scenario are approximately a third higher than in the most conservative one.
items.notes: a third higher 表示以较低情景为基数多三分之一。

items.zh: 该系列从二〇一二年才开始，因此更早年份无法直接比较。
items.en: The series begins only in 2012, preventing direct comparison with earlier years.
answers: The series begins only in 2012, preventing direct comparison with earlier years.
items.notes: preventing 说明数据覆盖范围带来的限制。

items.zh: 最后两个季度没有提供数据，因此不能描述完整的全年走势。
items.en: Figures for the final two quarters are unavailable, so a complete annual trend cannot be described.
answers: Figures for the final two quarters are unavailable, so a complete annual trend cannot be described.
Figures for the final two quarters are unavailable, so a complete annual trend can't be described.
items.notes: unavailable 表示数据缺失，不等于数值为零。

items.zh: 图表比较的是三年的快照，而不是连续的年度记录。
items.en: The charts compare snapshots from three years rather than a continuous annual record.
answers: The charts compare snapshots from three years rather than a continuous annual record.
items.notes: snapshot：某时点的概况；不据离散时点假定连续走势。

items.zh: 地图展示了拟议中的布局，并未表明施工已经完成。
items.en: The map presents a proposed layout and does not indicate that construction has been completed.
answers: The map presents a proposed layout and does not indicate that construction has been completed.
The map presents a proposed layout and doesn't indicate that construction has been completed.
items.notes: proposed 限定地图为规划图。

items.zh: 两组调查采用了不同的年龄分界，因而无法精确匹配。
items.en: The two surveys use different age boundaries and therefore cannot be matched precisely.
answers: The two surveys use different age boundaries and therefore cannot be matched precisely.
The two surveys use different age boundaries and therefore can't be matched precisely.
items.notes: age boundaries：年龄分组界限。

items.zh: 检验合格的零件进入组装环节，其余零件返回加工站。
items.en: Parts that pass inspection proceed to assembly; the rest return to the processing station.
answers: Parts that pass inspection proceed to assembly; the rest return to the processing station.
items.notes: the rest 回指未通过检验的零件。

items.zh: 混合物冷却期间，空容器在另一条生产线上接受消毒。
items.en: While the mixture cools, empty containers are sterilised on a separate production line.
answers: While the mixture cools, empty containers are sterilised on a separate production line.
items.notes: while 表示两个步骤同时进行。

items.zh: 蒸汽推动涡轮机之后凝结成水，并被泵送回锅炉。
items.en: After driving the turbine, the steam condenses into water and is pumped back to the boiler.
answers: After driving the turbine, the steam condenses into water and is pumped back to the boiler.
items.notes: condense：凝结；back 表明循环返回。

items.zh: 两种原料分别储存，直到称重阶段才混合。
items.en: The two raw materials are stored separately and combined only at the weighing stage.
answers: The two raw materials are stored separately and combined only at the weighing stage.
items.notes: only at 限定合流发生的位置。

items.zh: 包装环节结束后，每箱产品都会被贴上标明生产日期的标签。
items.en: Once packing is complete, each box is labelled with its production date.
answers: Once packing is complete, each box is labelled with its production date.
items.notes: once 引出完成前一步的条件。

items.zh: 与直线型流程不同，图示流程将材料从最后一步送回起点。
items.en: Unlike a linear process, the one shown returns material from the final stage to the starting point.
answers: Unlike a linear process, the one shown returns material from the final stage to the starting point.
items.notes: unlike 比较两种流程；the one shown 指图示流程。

items.zh: 水通过细筛时，较大的颗粒会被截留。
items.en: As water passes through a fine screen, larger particles are retained.
answers: As water passes through a fine screen, larger particles are retained.
items.notes: as 表示同步过程；retain：截留。

items.zh: 这套系统有两个输入端，但只有一个成品输出端。
items.en: The system has two inputs but a single output for the finished product.
answers: The system has two inputs but a single output for the finished product.
items.notes: input 和 output 描述流程边界。

items.zh: 种子吸水后膨胀，随后外壳裂开。
items.en: The seed swells as it absorbs water, after which its outer coat splits.
answers: The seed swells as it absorbs water, after which its outer coat splits.
items.notes: after which 承接前面的过程。

items.zh: 幼虫附着在叶片下侧，并在那里形成蛹。
items.en: The larva attaches itself to the underside of a leaf, where it forms a pupa.
answers: The larva attaches itself to the underside of a leaf, where it forms a pupa.
items.notes: larva 和 pupa 分别为幼虫与蛹。

items.zh: 沉积物逐层堆积，逐渐将有机物埋在下面。
items.en: Layers of sediment accumulate, gradually burying organic matter beneath them.
answers: Layers of sediment accumulate, gradually burying organic matter beneath them.
items.notes: 现在分词 burying 描述伴随结果。

items.zh: 浮标随波浪上下移动，带动与其相连的活塞。
items.en: The buoy rises and falls with the waves, moving the piston attached to it.
answers: The buoy rises and falls with the waves, moving the piston attached to it.
items.notes: attached to it 限定与浮标连接的活塞。

items.zh: 阀门打开后，压缩空气从储气室流向涡轮。
items.en: Opening the valve allows compressed air to flow from the chamber towards the turbine.
answers: Opening the valve allows compressed air to flow from the chamber towards the turbine.
items.notes: allow ... to do 描述装置功能。

items.zh: 阳光穿过透明盖板，并加热下方的黑色表面。
items.en: Sunlight passes through the transparent cover and heats the black surface underneath.
answers: Sunlight passes through the transparent cover and heats the black surface underneath.
items.notes: underneath 作副词表示盖板下方。

items.zh: 根部吸收的水沿着茎向上输送，最终到达叶片。
items.en: Water absorbed by the roots is transported up the stem to the leaves.
answers: Water absorbed by the roots is transported up the stem to the leaves.
items.notes: 过去分词短语 absorbed by 修饰 water。

items.zh: 容器装满时，浮子升起并切断进水。
items.en: When the container is full, a float rises and shuts off the water supply.
answers: When the container is full, a float rises and shuts off the water supply.
items.notes: shut off：切断；float 指浮子装置。

items.zh: 入口旁的售票处被迁到主楼内，腾出的空间改为自行车停车区。
items.en: The ticket office beside the entrance was relocated inside the main building, freeing space for bicycle parking.
answers: The ticket office beside the entrance was relocated inside the main building, freeing space for bicycle parking.
items.notes: freeing space 说明迁移后的空间用途。

items.zh: 原先相互分开的两间教室被合并成一间实验室。
items.en: Two previously separate classrooms were combined into a single laboratory.
answers: Two previously separate classrooms were combined into a single laboratory.
items.notes: combine ... into：将多个空间合并。

items.zh: 新桥建成后，行人可以直接从车站到达河对岸的住宅区。
items.en: The new bridge gives pedestrians direct access from the station to housing across the river.
answers: The new bridge gives pedestrians direct access from the station to housing across the river.
items.notes: give access to 描述新增连接带来的通达性。

items.zh: 树林的北半部保留了下来，南半部则被清理用于修建运动场。
items.en: The northern half of the woodland was retained, while the southern half was cleared for sports pitches.
answers: The northern half of the woodland was retained, while the southern half was cleared for sports pitches.
items.notes: retain 与 clear 对比保留和清理。

items.zh: 通往工厂的道路被改道，绕过了村庄中心。
items.en: The access road to the factory was rerouted to bypass the village centre.
answers: The access road to the factory was rerouted to bypass the village centre.
items.notes: reroute：改道；bypass：绕过。

items.zh: 所有面向顾客的服务现在集中在底层，办公室则位于楼上。
items.en: All customer-facing services are now on the ground floor, with offices upstairs.
answers: All customer-facing services are now on the ground floor, with offices upstairs.
items.notes: with 补充上下楼层的功能分区。

items.zh: 露天庭院加上了屋顶，成为连接两座建筑的大厅。
items.en: The open courtyard was roofed over to create a hall linking the two buildings.
answers: The open courtyard was roofed over to create a hall linking the two buildings.
items.notes: roof over：加盖屋顶；linking 限定新大厅的连接功能。

items.zh: 除了东北角新增的出口外，外围围墙没有改动。
items.en: The perimeter wall was left unaltered apart from a new exit in the north-east corner.
answers: The perimeter wall was left unaltered apart from a new exit in the north-east corner.
items.notes: apart from 引出保留部分中的唯一变化。
